source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.4.2 (PDF 216), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Marketing plan mein tafseel hoti hai ke target market tak kaise pohanchna hai. Is mein promotional channels (product ko logon tak pohanchane ke raaste) chunna shamil hai, jaise social media, television ya word-of-mouth (logon ka aapas mein ek doosre ko batana).

Misal: Pakistani masalon ka naya brand launch karte waqt cooking shows par ad (ishtihar) dena, ya aise social media influencers (jin ki baat bohat log sunte hain) ke saath kaam karna jo traditional Pakistani khanon par content banate hain, effective (faidemand) hoga.

blocks.prompt: Masalon ka brand sports channel ke bajaye cooking show par ishtihar kyun de?
blocks.explanation: Cooking show dekhne wale hi woh log hain jo sab se zyada masale khareedte hain, is liye ishtihar ka paisa sahi logon tak pohanchta hai.

items: Marketing plan: woh channels chunein jo target customers tak pohanchein (cooking shows, influencers).
